title: Petition of Marathon Lines, Inc. for a Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity under the provisions of Massachusetts General Laws, Chapter 159A, Section 7 for the operation of motor vehicles for the carriage of passengers for hire over certain public ways in the Cities of Boston and Waltham, and the Town of Acton, Ayer, Concord, Harvard, Lexington, Lincoln, Littleton, Shirley and Weston and the public ways under the jurisdiction of the Massachusetts Turnpike Authority.
